name: Hanging Woman
message: "Hey... can you... see me?"
"Yes."
"No."
(Don't answer)

name: Hanging Woman
message: "Were you just... staring at the tree?"

name: Hanging Woman
message: "My mistake. What a shame..."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "My... you can even hear me?"

name: Hanging Woman
message: "Some... see me now and then, but you're the first I can actually talk to."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "Oh, please don't make that face."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "I'm perfectly fine hanging around like this."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "I'm already dead, after all."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "Yes. I'm a ghost, you see. Ehehe..."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "Oh. You're not worried... You're scared, aren't you?"

name: Hanging Woman
message: "How careless of me, I'm sorry. I'll get down right away."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "Phew..."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "I must have startled you. I'm sorry."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "Don't worry, I'm not going to curse you or anything. I really won't. I'd never lay a finger on anyone."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "I'm not hanging around here out of resentment. I just have some... circumstances."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "Perhaps fate has tied us together somehow..."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "Hey, if you don't mind... would you listen to my request?"
"Yes."
"No."
"No."
"No."
"No."
"No."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "Right... of course. I *am* a ghost, after all. I must seem so creepy to you."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "But I swear, I really won't hurt you."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "Could you at least... listen to what I have to say?"

name: Hanging Woman
message: "People notice me sometimes... Only sometimes, though."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "But they never hear me."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "You, on the other hand... You're the first one I can actually talk to."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "If you turn me down... I don't know if I'll ever get another chance."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "So please... please..."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "You may have already realized, but..."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "I won't budge until you say yes."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "I'm a ghost, after all. I have all the time in the world."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "...I understand."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "If you're that against it... I suppose I can't force you."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "I'm sorry for being so pushy. I won't bother you anymore."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "But... if you ever have a change of heart, would you come and see me?"

name: Hanging Woman
message: "I'll probably still be here tomorrow."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "Okay then... Let's meet again."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "...Really? Thank you."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "I was sure you'd say no. I guess you'll never know unless you try..."

name: Hanging Woman
message: "Hmm... Let's see... Where should I start?"

name: Hanging Woman
message: "Ah, first... my name."

name: Shiori
message: "My name is... Kugayama, Shiori. It's nice to meet you."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, and I know I said 'first,' but the truth is... there isn't really a second or a third. The only thing I remember is my name."

name: Shiori
message: "When did I die, and why? Where did I live? How old was I? What were my hobbies?"

name: Shiori
message: "I can't remember any of it. Aside from my name, everything's gone."

name: Shiori
message: "And since I remember nothing, I don't have any real attachments to this world."

name: Shiori
message: "In short... I have no idea why I'm still here."

name: Shiori
message: "I figured I'd finally find peace if I died again, so I tried hanging myself, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "As you can see, it didn't work."

name: Shiori
message: "Actually, this wasn't my first attempt... at suicide, I mean."

name: Shiori
message: "No matter how many times I die, I just can't seem to go to heaven. Or hell, for that matter."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe I just forgot, and I actually do have strong regrets tying me to this world—"

name: Shiori
message: "—some sort of unfinished business I left behind..."

name: Shiori
message: "......Sorry for the long introduction. I'll get to the point now."

name: Shiori
message: "I want you to help me get my memories back."

name: Shiori
message: "Since I only know my name, I have no idea where to begin..."

name: Shiori
message: "Besides, there's only so much a ghost can do."

name: Shiori
message: "At this rate, I'll just keep dying, again and again for eternity..."

name: Shiori
message: "So please. If you feel even a little pity for me..."

name: Shiori
message: "No, that was unfair of me. I basically pressured you into saying yes."

name: Shiori
message: "...How about this? There's a convenience store just around the corner."

name: Shiori
message: "If you're willing to help, could you come meet me there?"

name: Shiori
message: "If you don't feel like it, you can go home, and I'll never bother you ever again."

name: Shiori
message: "See you there."
Time to go.
(Convenience store)
(Go home)

name: Shiori
message: "You really came. I'm so glad."

name: Shiori
message: "To be honest, I was getting worried. It must be unsettling, getting a request from a ghost like this."

name: Shiori
message: "But you still came. Thank you, I'm really happy."

name: Shiori
message: "I'd like to start searching for my memories right away, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "Like I said, I don't remember anything, so I don't even know where to begin."

name: Shiori
message: "So I thought I'd ask for advice."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, not you, but my friend—my only ghost friend, to be exact."

name: Shiori
message: "She's why I asked you to come here, so you could meet her."

name: Shiori
message: "Follow me. She should be right over there."

name: Shiori
message: "Hello?"

name: Young Woman
message: "Hmm? Yo."

name: Shiori
message: "Do you have a moment?"

name: Young Woman
message: "Hm? Yeah, sure."

name: Shiori
message: "I want to get my memories back."

name: Young Woman
message: "Okay, that *so* came outta nowhere."

name: Young Woman
message: "Figured you'd just up and disappear someday. Did something happen?"

name: Young Woman
message: "Eh, whatever. Go on."

name: Shiori
message: "I figured you might know something."

name: Young Woman
message: "About you?"

name: Shiori
message: "That, or a way to get my memories back."

name: Young Woman
message: "Yeah, I dunno. I don't have mine either. Heck, I don't even know my own name."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh. Not even that?"

name: Young Woman
message: "Hm? What, you remember yours or something?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes. Nothing else, though."

name: Shiori
message: "Kugayama, Shiori. That's my name."

name: Young Woman
message: "Kugayama... Shiori..."

name: Shiori
message: "Does it ring any bells?"

name: Young Woman
message: "Nope. Not at all. Anyway, can I call you Shiorin?"

name: Shiori
message: "Okay."

name: Young Woman
message: "You can call me whatever you want. Anything's fine."

name: Shiori
message: "Really? In that case, I've actually already been secretly calling you..."

name: Shiori
message: "Gyaruko-san."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ew, lame."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh, whatever. I *did* tell you to call me whatever you want."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "How about you—"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah, wait... Come to think of it..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Maybe coming to me was the right call. I don't have any memories, but I do know a lot of peeps."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I just remembered someone who knows a lot about ghosts and stuff. Could help you out."

name: Shiori
message: "Like a medium or something?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Nah, a ghost just like us. Someone who's been one for a *long* time."

name: Shiori
message: "So, a ghost who knows a lot about ghosts?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hmm, how do I put it? More like, she's willing to dig up whatever you need, I guess."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Not just ghost stuff."

name: Shiori
message: "Where can we find this person?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Probably... the library, like always. Second floor, uh, somewhere."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I forgot the exact spot, but you'll know right away."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Even when it's crowded, there's always this empty spot there. Probably gives people the chills or something."

name: Shiori
message: "An empty spot, even when crowded... Thanks, we'll try looking for it."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yeah. And if you figure anything out, tell me too, 'kay? I'm kinda curious."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, of course. See you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Mm-hm, see ya~. You too, buh-bye!"
"Goodbye."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hold up, buddy."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I just helped you out. Now, what do you say when someone helps you?"

name: Shiori
message: "You're surprisingly uptight."

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry to ask when I'm just making you tag along, but could you thank Gyaruko-san too?"
"Thank you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Mm-hm. Good."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Alrighty then, Good luck~"

name: Shiori
message: "Right. We'll be off now. Thanks for the info."

name: Shiori
message: "Our next stop is the library. Now then, shall we get going?"
(Library)

name: Shiori
message: "Now then..."

name: Shiori
message: "An empty spot even when it's crowded... our ghost should be the only one there."

name: Shiori
message: "Well, this is a pickle. There are barely any people, and everyone's sitting alone."

name: Shiori
message: "But... since we're both ghosts, I think I can single her out. Like through her presence, or aura... or something like that."

name: Shiori
message: "...That must be her. Follow me."

name: Shiori
message: "Excuse me, can we sit here?"

name: Glasses Woman
message: "...Go ahead."

name: Shiori
message: "Good, we have our ghost."

name: Shiori
message: "Go on, take a seat. You can sit beside me."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "...Please refrain from talking inside the library."

name: Shiori
message: "Just like how no one can hear you, people can't hear me either."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "I see. So you're one of us."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes. I'm glad we found you right away."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "It's rare for this place to have two ghostly visitors at once."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, I'm the only one who's dead."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "... All the more unusual, then. A living person who can see and talk to ghosts, are you?"

name: Glasses Woman
message: "In that case, allow me to give you another warning."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Please refrain from talking. Unlike us, people can hear you, and you might disturb them. Understood?"
"Yes."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Phew..."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "I suppose I share the blame for prompting a reply."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "I will say this one more time, clearly. Do not utter a word."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "For your response, simply nod or shake your head. That will suffice."
"Yes."
(Nod)

name: Glasses Woman
message: "...Are you messing with me?"

name: Glasses Woman
message: "That was close. I was about to lose it back there. You're lucky I'm a rational ghost."

name: Shiori
message: "...This reminds me of back with Gyaruko-san."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Good. I'm glad you understand."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "...Very well, I suppose I should explain this properly."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "While following the rules is a given, it's also for both our sakes."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Since you can mingle with our kind, I'm sure you sensed it. When you answered 'yes', my demeanor changed."

name: Shiori
message: "I felt it too. It was the same with Gyaruko-san."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Pardon?"

name: Shiori
message: "The girl who's always on her phone in front of the convenience store."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "On her phone? ...Ah, her."

name: Shiori
message: "She suddenly got upset, and there was this strange... aura? Anyway, she felt really dangerous."

name: Shiori
message: "Just like what I felt from you."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "You probably set off her trigger, or came close to it."

name: Shiori
message: "'Trigger'...?"

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Things a ghost finds unbearable, you could say."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "For reasons unknown, we ghosts have trouble controlling our emotions."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Anyone who's been one long enough realizes this naturally, especially when it comes to anger."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "I was a very rational person in life, but now it's like I've become a kettle that instantly boils over."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "My trigger is breaking library rules."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "When someone breaks them in front of me, the rage shoots straight to my head."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "But as I am a rational, level-headed ghost, I know how to restrain myself. However..."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Should you break the rules again, I can't guarantee what will happen. At worst, I could end up cursing you to death."

name: Shiori
message: "I see... My buddy here might've accidentally set off Gyaruko-san's trigger, then."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Forgive my meddling, but you don't seem very experienced at talking with ghosts, so let me give you a warning."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Rule 1: *Never* set off a ghost's trigger."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Each ghost has their own triggers and reactions. Some just get angry, while others will show outright murderous intent."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "I myself don't know what I'd do either. Be careful, and assume there won't be a next time."
"Yes."
(Nod)

name: Glasses Woman
message: "I said... there wouldn't be a next time."
(Try again)
(Return to Title Screen)

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Good, an excellent response."

name: Shiori
message: "I wonder if I have any triggers too..."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "I couldn't say, but I'm sure you do."

name: Shiori
message: "...It sure is tough having no memories."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "I see. So that's why you're here."

name: Shiori
message: "Hm?"

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Gyaruko-san, was it? I suppose she told you that there was someone knowledgeable about ghostly affairs."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "That this 'someone' might know a way for you to recover your memories from when you were alive. Which brings you here today."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Is that correct?"

name: Shiori
message: "You're... completely right."

name: Shiori
message: "Wow, you're sharp. It must be those glasses."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "That's quite the prejudice you have there. But I don't dislike it, so I'll let it slide."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "It was a simple deduction. It's not uncommon for ghosts to lose their memories."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "When you linger in this world long enough, you naturally get your share of similar inquiries."

name: Shiori
message: "You really are a veteran ghost... Ah, I'm sorry. I've yet to introduce myself. I'm—"

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Ah, stop right there. That won't be necessary."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh... right. Not everyone remembers their name... That was insensitive of me."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "No, I do remember. Not everything, but I still retain memories from when I was alive."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "But I have no intention of telling you, nor will I ask for your names."

name: Shiori
message: "I understand. A lone wolf who walks her own path... I guess you don't want to join a pack."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "What? No."

name: Shiori
message: "Hm?"

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Which brings us to Rule 2."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "The more you learn about someone, the closer you become. In short, you start getting attached."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "As I said earlier, ghosts have trouble regulating their emotions."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Any attachment you form will become a fixation, and eventually a curse."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "And if that curse is directed at the living..."

name: Shiori
message: "...They could get possessed or killed?"

name: Glasses Woman
message: "That sort of thing can happen, yes."

name: Shiori
message: "Come to think of it... when I first met my buddy here in the park, I introduced myself right away, but I never asked for a name."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe I subconsciously knew I shouldn't."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Perhaps."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "If you don't know someone's name, it's best to keep it that way."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Once you learn it, familiarity follows, then fixation, and eventually a curse."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Before you realize it, you could turn into a wraith and end up harming the friend you finally made."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "So please be careful."

name: Shiori
message: "It's a little lonely, but I guess I should maintain a proper distance."

name: Shiori
message: "I understand, thanks. You really know your stuff."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "I haven't been a ghost this long for nothing."

name: Shiori
message: "For now... Let's see, what should I call you?"

name: Shiori
message: "You're wearing a hat, so... Hatter? Or maybe Boushi-san?"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, but if I were to give you a nickname, I might start getting attached."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe it'd be safest to just keep calling you 'you,' then."

name: Shiori
message: "Though I suppose calling everyone I meet 'you' might get a tad confusing..."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Call me whatever you like. You won't get attached to me, not while you're still looking for your lost memories, at least."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's see, in that case... Ms. Glasses. No... that's too on the nose."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "Indeed. I dislike it."

name: Shiori
message: "I just realized, I have absolutely no naming sense..."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "For what it's worth, I was a librarian here when I was alive."

name: Glasses Woman
message: "It was a long time ago. Back when this library was new, the librarian's desk used to be right here."

name: Shiori
message: "The librarian... Shisho-san... Ms. Librarian, then? Though that still might be a bit on the nose."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "That should be fine. It's the name I'm most used to."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Then I shall call you the Traveler of Memories, and Her Buddy."

name: Shiori
message: "Wow, that's far more poetic than anything I came up with."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Of course. I have spent a long time in this library, after all."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "No... my story doesn't matter. We should focus on solving your problem, Ms. Traveler."

name: Shiori
message: "Does that mean you can really help us? Do you know a way?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'm afraid I can't give you the answer itself. My job is to help with the search, as a librarian should."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It's up to you to decide what counts as an answer."

name: Shiori
message: "A model librarian, then. How reassuring."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Is there any habit you've continued without fail, even after losing your memories?"

name: Shiori
message: "A habit...? Nothing really comes to mind..."

name: Shiori
message: "No, wait."

name: Shiori
message: "If I had to name something, then... suicide?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You've been committing suicide, even after becoming a ghost?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, over and over. I thought maybe I could pass on that way."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "And you still keep doing it? Even after realizing it didn't work?"

name: Shiori
message: "I... guess. Or that's how it ended up, at least."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It seems you have a fixation on the act of suicide, or perhaps, on death itself."

name: Shiori
message: "A fixation...? It doesn't really feel like that... but maybe it is."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Perhaps you didn't get a proper death, which is why you're searching for the right one."

name: Shiori
message: "A proper death..."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm starting to feel like that might be true."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Try looking for news related to a woman's suicide, or incidents and accidents involving women. You might find a lead."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'll go through the newspapers from the past few years. Give me some time."

name: Shiori
message: "You'd do all that for me?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'm a librarian, after all. Come back here after a while. I'll report what I find."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you. Ah... in that case..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Did you remember something?"

name: Shiori
message: "No. I just figured I really should tell you my name. It might appear in one of the articles, after all."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Right."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm Shiori. Kugayama, Shiori."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Kugayama Shiori-san, was it? I've committed it to memory."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I only realized once you brought it up, but it does make things easier if your name comes up in the articles."

name: Shiori
message: "What do you mean?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "We can search your name on the internet."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Touchscreens don't respond to our kind, so we can't use smartphones, but keyboards work just fine."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "That said, we don't get along well with electronic devices, so don't expect much from a computer-based investigation."

name: Shiori
message: "We... don't?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "When I try to use a computer, strange things keep happening. The screen freezes, or turns blue, and so on."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "We probably emit some kind of frequency that interferes with electronics."

name: Shiori
message: "...I see."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "However, that should be no problem for your buddy. Asking the living for help was a wise choice."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, that's true. There's only so much I can do on my own; that's why I asked my buddy here for help."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, right, the internet... It never even crossed my mind. My search might be shorter than I expected."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If you're going to use your phone, please do it outside."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh... but it's just a quick search."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It's not against the rules, but I'm rather old-fashioned, you see."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Watching someone fiddle with a phone offends my ghostly sensibilities."

name: Shiori
message: "So it's one of your triggers, then..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'll check the newspapers as well, just in case. Come back another day."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, thank you."
"Thank you."
(Strike a gratitude pose)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...You whispered, and meant no harm, so I'll let that one slide."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You're lucky I'm a reasonable and level-headed ghost."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Huh? Yes? ...Hm? What are you..."

name: Shiori
message: "Since the living can't talk here, that's probably my buddy's way of showing gratitude."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Ah... Yes, you're welcome..."

name: Shiori
message: "Well then, shall we get going?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Please wait. I forgot to tell you something."

name: Shiori
message: "What is it?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I've met and seen off many ghosts over the years."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "And the ones who've lost their memories almost always meet the same end."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "They lose their ego, and eventually, their very existence."

name: Shiori
message: "The loss of the ego... You mean I'd stop being me?"

name: Shiori
message: "What should I do, then?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I recommend not relying too heavily on your own memories."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Leaving behind your thoughts and feelings in some form may also help."

name: Shiori
message: "In some form... Like a diary, maybe?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Though even that isn't foolproof. You've already forgotten everything except your name—"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "—so I suggest you hurry."

name: Shiori
message: "I see... Thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "See you again, Ms. Librarian. Please take care of the newspaper articles for us."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Of course. You can count on me."

name: Shiori
message: "Hey, there's a bench over there. Let's take a seat and... ah."

name: Shiori
message: "I just went on assuming you had one, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "Do you... have a smartphone?"
"Yes."
"No."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, thank goodness. For now, let's take a seat."

name: Shiori
message: "It'd be nice if we could find something right away, but I doubt it'll be that—"

name: Shiori
message: "Kyah!"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... that surprised me. Looks like you've got a call."

name: Shiori
message: "Don't mind me, go ahead and answer it. It might be important."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh? ...You don't have one?"

name: Shiori
message: "Well, this is troubling. Maybe there's somewhere we can get online and..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, the library has computers. We can head back to—"

name: Shiori
message: "Kyah! Wh-What was that?"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, a call..."

name: Shiori
message: "Huh? Isn't that... a smartphone?"

name: Shiori
message: "I can't believe you just casually pulled your phone out right after you lied about it... You're definitely something..."

name: Shiori
message: "It's okay, I'm not mad. I love that kind of humor."

name: Shiori
message: "Don't mind me, go ahead and answer it. It might be important."
The text looks strange somehow.
And I'm sure I switched it to silent mode.

name: Shiori
message: "Something wrong? ...My."

name: Shiori
message: "Your screen is looking weird... and the ringtone sounds kind of creepy..."

name: Shiori
message: "Could this be... some sort of paranormal phenomenon? Maybe it's because you got involved with me?"

name: Shiori
message: "What should we do? I think you shouldn't answer it..."
(Answer it)
(Answer it)
(Don't answer it)
(Don't answer it)
(Don't answer it)
The decline button isn't working.

name: Shiori
message: "So it's not giving us a choice..."

name: Shiori
message: "This is starting to feel more and more paranormal..."
The decline button won't work, no matter how many times I try.

name: Shiori
message: "I think... I have an idea who's calling."

name: Shiori
message: "Still, scary things are scary..."

name: Shiori
message: "Looks like it's not letting us go... I guess we've got no choice..."

name: Shiori
message: "...Wow. You didn't even think twice about answering it..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah... Yo, it really worked!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah, it worked. And hey, pick up faster next time, yeah?"

name: Shiori
message: "That voice... Gyaruko-san?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yup, yup. It's me~"

name: Shiori
message: "You two... didn't exchange numbers without me noticing, right?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Nah, that's not it. 'Sides, my phone ain't even on."

name: Shiori
message: "...Then how is this call even happening?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Beats me. Probably through the power of ghosthood, or something."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Sooo, I was just wondering if you two found her. But, like, going over there is such a pain, yeah?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Then I remembered I had a phone, or something like it."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Anyway, I imagined it real hard—and it worked."

name: Shiori
message: "That's rather... vague. But I guess we shouldn't expect any logic from paranormal phenomena."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh, it worked, so who cares?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So? Did you find her?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, she agreed to help us."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Oh, nice~. Tell me if you find out anything, 'kay~?"

name: Shiori
message: "Of course. First, we'll try searching the internet for clues—Hm?"

name: Shiori
message: "Looks like she hung up."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay then, let's take a seat and start browsing."

name: Shiori
message: "Or rather, let's take a seat and you start browsing. I can only watch, after all."

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry for making you do all the work. I'm counting on you."

name: Shiori
message: "Now then... let's see if my name shows up."

name: Shiori
message: "Do you know how to spell it? Ku as in long time, ga as in self, and yama as in mountain. And Shiori is just the usual bookmark."

name: Shiori
message: "I think both should come up in the spelling suggestions."
(Kugayama, Shiori)

name: Shiori
message: "No good, huh. Too bad..."

name: Shiori
message: "But at least we know a couple of things now. Whatever happened to me wasn't newsworthy, and I didn't leave any sort of digital trail."

name: Shiori
message: "It just occurred to me... is Kugayama Shiori really my name?"

name: Shiori
message: "It could be the name of someone involved in my death... right? With no memories, I can't be sure."

name: Shiori
message: "But even if it's someone else's name, we don't have any other leads right now."

name: Shiori
message: "The one thing we do know for sure is that I'm fixated on suicide—on death. So let's try that angle next."

name: Shiori
message: "But a woman's suicide... is probably too general. We're going to need to narrow it down..."

name: Shiori
message: "Come to think of it... I'm wearing a uniform, aren't I? That would make me a student... probably a high schooler."

name: Shiori
message: "We could identify my uniform and narrow things down, but... this sailor uniform is pretty plain, so that might be tough..."

name: Shiori
message: "Besides, am I even a student? What if I was just cosplaying?"

name: Shiori
message: "...Okay, that was a bit scary. Let's pretend that possibility doesn't exist."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's see... can you try searching for 'high school girl', 'suicide', and... a location?"
(High school girl, suicide, Hikarigadai)

name: Shiori
message: "...... 'Hit by train, dead', 'Murder staged as suicide'. It's all accidents and crime reports."

name: Shiori
message: "I mean, I wouldn't mind looking into those too, but—Wait. There."

name: Shiori
message: "'High school girl found dead after falling from apartment, suicide suspected...'"

name: Shiori
message: "......It's from around five years ago. Based on the scene, the police believe she climbed over the waist-high railing in the shared corridor and are investigating further..."

name: Shiori
message: "To be honest, it doesn't really ring a bell... But we might as well check it out anyway."

name: Shiori
message: "The problem is figuring out where the scene actually is. Pinpointing the apartment might be tough..."

name: Shiori
message: "...? Social media?"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, right, someone who knows the place might have posted about it. Wow, you're smart."

name: Shiori
message: "We should look for posts and updates about the suicide and connect the dots from there..."

name: Shiori
message: "...Huh? Ah... you've already found it...?"

name: Shiori
message: "Wow... You're surfing the internet like a pro... Or is it just me? Am I actually from an older era?"

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry, that doesn't matter right now. There's a picture of the apartment in the post too."

name: Shiori
message: "They're completely ignoring the deceased's privacy... Modern people are scary..."

name: Shiori
message:
"...... 
I think... I know this building. Yeah, I know this place... It should be close by."

name: Shiori
message: "It's still not ringing any bells... But did I really kill myself at this apartment building...?"

name: Shiori
message: "No, there's no point overthinking it... Let's just go. I'll know once I get there."

name: Shiori
message: "...Maybe. Probably. I'm sure."
(Scene of the suicide)

name: Shiori
message: "To be honest, I wasn't sure if I could bring us here, but... what a relief. Looks like we made it."

name: Shiori
message: "Can you show me the photo of the apartment building, just in case?"

name: Shiori
message: "...Yeah. This is it. There's no doubt about it."

name: Shiori
message: "My memories of this place... are they from before or after I died?"

name: Shiori
message: "I've been wandering all over ever since I became a ghost, but I don't remember ever coming here..."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe I really did live here..."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm jumping."

name: Shiori
message: "If I really did kill myself here, then reenacting it should jog my memory."

name: Shiori
message: "That girl climbed over the waist-high railing and jumped, right? The article didn't say which floor it was."

name: Shiori
message: "If I'm going to do it, might as well jump from the roof..."

name: Shiori
message: "You know how rooftops are usually off-limits, right? But now that I'm a ghost, that doesn't apply anymore. It's my big chance."

name: Shiori
message: "Don't you think rooftops have a certain charm? Like the ones at school?"
"I get it."
"I don't get it."

name: Shiori
message: "I know, right? I knew you'd get it. There's just something about rooftops that draws people in."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh... is that so? Heights can be scary, so I understand."

name: Shiori
message:
"Anyway, I'm going to jump. From the roof. As they say:
I   c a n   f l y!"

name: Shiori
message: "The only problem is... how do we get up there?"

name: Shiori
message: "I'm the kind of ghost who's still bound by physics, so I can't just float my way up there..."

name: Shiori
message: "Whatever happens, happens, I guess."

name: Shiori
message: "You wait here, okay? Otherwise, it'd count as trespassing."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay then, I'm off. Time for a graceful dive."

name: Shiori
message: "Wow~, ehehe, this is starting to get kind of fun."

name: Shiori
message: "I made it somehow~! I'm going to jump now~!"

name: Shiori
message: "I'm kinda freaking out~! It's way higher than I thought!"

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, I lied~! I'm REALLY freaking out right now~!"

name: Shiori
message: "But since I've come all this way, I'm going to jump~! I'm already dead, so I've got nothing to lose~!"

name: Shiori
message: "Okay! I'm jumping! I'm going to jump!"

name: Shiori
message: "Here I gooooo!"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, don't worry. I'm still alive."

name: Shiori
message: "Wait no, I'm not. Let me rephrase: I'm still here and conscious."

name: Shiori
message: "Looks like ghosts can tweak their appearance if they want, at least to some extent."

name: Shiori
message: "I tried imagining what I'd look like if I died from falling..."

name: Shiori
message: "But since I can't see myself, I'm not sure if I did it right..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... I guess it's not very convincing when I'm talking so normally. I need to sound more pained."

name: Shiori
message: "U-Ugh... i-it... hurts... h-help... meee..."

name: Shiori
message: "Well? Did I at least set the mood—"

name: Shiori
message: "Hm?"

name: Shiori
message: "Did you just... take a picture? Of my corpse?"

name: Shiori
message: "I'm supposed to be the one scaring you, but that was so unexpected you ended up spooking me instead... What's gotten into you all of a sudden?"
"To commemorate."
"I just felt like it."

name: Shiori
message: "To commemorate...? Right, to commemorate... So it's commemorative..."

name: Shiori
message: "You just... felt like it? It happens, I guess."

name: Shiori
message: "Come to think of it, do I even show up in photos? Can I see it?"

name: Shiori
message: "Alright... there. Whew... Shapeshifting is tiring."

name: Shiori
message: "So, how was it? Does it look good?"
(Show her the photo)

name: Shiori
message: "Wow... amazing. It came out so nicely... To think a ghost would show up this clearly—"

name: Shiori
message: "No, wait, hold on. This is brutal. Downright grotesque. I mean, I know I did this myself, but this is horrible..."

name: Shiori
message: "I can't believe you actually thought of taking a picture... People say I'm weird, but you're quite something too..."

name: Shiori
message: "People... often say... I'm weird...?"

name: Shiori
message: "...Who did?"

name: Shiori
message: "Nothing clicked even after I jumped. I didn't remember anything in particular."

name: Shiori
message: "So whoever died here... probably wasn't me. I think."

name: Shiori
message: "But... although I couldn't remember anything important, it feels like a blurry outline of myself is coming into focus."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you. I feel like I've regained a tiny bit of myself thanks to you."

name: Shiori
message: "...It's getting dark."

name: Shiori
message: "We've finished looking into the scene, so why don't we call it a day?"

name: Shiori
message: "I'll walk you home—Wait, no. I guess it's better if I don't know where you live."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's head back to the park. The one where we first met."

name: Shiori
message: "We'll part ways there for today. Thanks, really. For going along with my sudden request."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, let's head back."
(Convenience store)

name: Shiori
message: "Oh... are you stopping by the convenience store?"

name: Shiori
message: "I was planning to report to Gyaruko-san another day, but yeah, let's do it today."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay then, off to the convenience store."

name: Shiori
message: "Too bad. Looks like she's not here."

name: Shiori
message: "She's here often... but like me, she wanders around a lot."

name: Shiori
message: "I don't know where she is right now. What do you think? Want to wait a bit?"
(Go shopping)

name: Shiori
message: "Okay. I'll wait here, then."

name: Shiori
message: "Welcome back. Did you get what you wanted?"
(Give her a gift)

name: Shiori
message: "Huh? For me...? Thank you. I wonder what's inside."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, but can I even physically touch things...?"

name: Shiori
message: "Well, I did say I was bound by the laws of physics."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, what am I saying? I'm walking around with my feet on the ground, so of course I can touch things. How silly of me."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you. I'm really happy, ehehe. Now, time to find out what's inside this bag."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's see... A notebook, a pen, and some tape. It's cute and colorful. And then... huh?"

name: Shiori
message: "...You printed that photo from earlier? I know it was just me, but it still made me jump."

name: Shiori
message: "Why would you—No, wait."

name: Shiori
message: "A notebook, a pen, some tape, and a photo... Put all of this together, and..."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, I get it. You're telling me to keep a record."

name: Shiori
message: "If I lose my memories, I'll eventually lose my ego, then finally, my existence."

name: Shiori
message: "But if I keep carving new memories into myself, I can stay as... me."

name: Shiori
message: "And for someone who's fixated on death like me, this photo is an important record that connects me to the self I've lost."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you. It's a wonderful present. I'll start using it right away."

name: Shiori
message: "I need to record what happened today, then. Before I forget."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, it's done. A notebook that records my deaths, a Death No—"

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah, no, that wasn't it. Phew, that was close."

name: Shiori
message: "Hmm... the Notebook of Doom... No, that makes it sound like anyone who reads it would die..."

name: Shiori
message: "Death... records... details of my deaths... Death Journal? Hm, probably needs a bit more flair."

name: Shiori
message: "Death Diary."

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah, it has a nice ring to it. Pretty cool, too. Like Enma's own Book of the Dead."

name: Shiori
message: "So I was thinking of filling the Death Diary with all sorts of memories... But you probably don't want to go through all that hassle."

name: Shiori
message: "My life has already ended. I just need to get my memories back before I pass on."

name: Shiori
message: "...The sun's about to set. I'll stay here a bit longer and wait for Gyaruko-san. You should head home."

name: Shiori
message: "Tomorrow, or the day after... or whenever, really. If you feel like it, come see me again. I'll be at the park."

name: Shiori
message: "Well then, see you again. And really, thank you for today. Get home safe."
